name: mrh-p6
description: Talk to your Primavera P6 Professional SQLite schedules: interactive in-chat dashboard, overview, activity search, health check, baseline slips, look-ahead, XER export and safe, undoable edits.

database.title: P6 database file
database.description: Optional full path of the P6 SQLite (.db) file to open automatically. Leave empty and ask Claude to open a file instead.

allow_edit.title: Allow editing
allow_edit.description: Off = read-only. On = editing tools are available (a backup is taken before the first edit). Run /reload-plugins after changing.
